--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[PAY-1] Server trusts client-supplied prices/amounts
File: src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts (L1-L200) and src/app/api/checkout/razorpay-order/route.ts (L1-L160)
Evidence: create-order accepts items[].price, subtotal and total from the request and persists them without reconciling against product.price; razorpay-order creates a Razorpay order using the client-sent amount instead of the server-side order total. This allows a malicious client to request/pay a lower amount.  
Impact: attackers can pay less than the true order value, causing direct revenue loss and incorrect accounting.  
Fix: always recompute subtotal/total server-side from product prices and quantities and use that DB-derived amount (not client input) when creating Razorpay orders.

File: src/app/api/checkout/verify-payment/route.ts (L1-L200) and src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/route.ts

finalReport.rawFindings:
--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[PAY-1] Server trusts client-supplied prices/amounts
File: src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts (L1-L200) and src/app/api/checkout/razorpay-order/route.ts (L1-L160)
Evidence: create-order accepts items[].price, subtotal and total from the request and persists them without reconciling against product.price; razorpay-order creates a Razorpay order using the client-sent amount instead of the server-side order total. This allows a malicious client to request/pay a lower amount.  
Impact: attackers can pay less than the true order value, causing direct revenue loss and incorrect accounting.  
Fix: always recompute subtotal/total server-side from product prices and quantities and use that DB-derived amount (not client input) when creating Razorpay orders.

--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[PAY-2] Stock decrement only occurs in client-verify path (race condition)
File: src/app/api/checkout/verify-payment/route.ts (L1-L200) and src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/route.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: verify-payment performs a transaction that sets status CONFIRMED and decrements stock, but the Razorpay webhook updates order.status to CONFIRMED and does not decrement stock; verify-payment bails out if order.status === 'CONFIRMED'. If the webhook arrives before the client verify call, stock decrement is skipped.  
Impact: intermittent oversells and inventory desync under normal asynchronous traffic, leading to unfulfilled orders and lost revenue.  
Fix: consolidate authoritative post-payment actions into the webhook (or make the webhook idempotently perform/delegate stock decrements) and ensure the stock-decrement is done exactly once in a single transactional path.

--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[PAY-3] Webhook processing is non-idempotent and performs external side-effects
File: src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/route.ts (L1-L300)
Evidence: webhook verifies signature but does not persist or check an incoming event ID or payment/order handled flag before performing side-effects; it unconditionally calls ShiprocketService.createOrder, which can create duplicate external shipment orders on retries.  
Impact: duplicate shipments / external charges and corrupted order-shipment mapping, causing financial loss and operational chaos.  
Fix: persist incoming webhook event IDs or Razorpay payment/order IDs with a unique constraint and skip re-processing if already handled; guard external API calls by checking existing shiprocketOrderId before creating.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[PAY-4] Inconsistent storage/lookup of Razorpay order IDs
File: prisma/schema.prisma (Order model) and src/app/api/checkout/razorpay-order/route.ts (L1-L120) and src/app/api/checkout/verify-payment/route.ts (L1-L120) and src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/route.ts (L1-L120)
Evidence: schema provides razorpayOrderId, but razorpay-order endpoint overwrites orderNumber with Razorpay order ID while verify-payment sets razorpayOrderId; webhook queries orders by orderNumber for payment.order_id.  
Impact: mismatched fields can cause webhooks or reconciliation lookups to fail, leaving captured payments unlinked to orders and causing fulfillment failures.  
Fix: standardize on a single explicit provider-id field (e.g., razorpayOrderId), add an indexed/unique constraint as needed, and update all code paths and webhook lookups to use it.

--- INFO ---

[PAY-5] Webhook signature verification implemented
File: src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/route.ts (L1-L120)
Evidence: webhook verifies x-razorpay-signature using HMAC-SHA256 against the configured webhook secret.
